status: published through successful CI; both public galleries and the regenerated serverless ZIP verified
owner_authorization: si procedi così per entrambe le gallery: crea il tab solo al click, riusa quello già aperto e poi verifica quanto migliorano i tempi
method: Three interleaved old/new Chromium contexts per environment. Each context visits with an empty browser cache, opens w01 and w02, reselects w01, then repeats. The same remote server, one CPU and 512 MiB per container, identical gzip level 6 and conditional browser-cache configuration. Four loopback-only proxy ports reached through a private SSH tunnel; these are controlled comparisons, not newly deployed public HTTPS measurements. Server processes were already warm. No concurrent test suites from this task during the final run. Small-sample times remain machine/network dependent.

verification.core_rechecks: 3556 passed in the initial complete run; 3 conformance and 5 generated-bundle checks passed after permitting loopback servers and rebuilding artifacts. Earlier incorrect-interpreter runs are not counted as code failures.
verification.browsers: Chromium and WebKit: Python and Node candidates; no initial iframes, one initial tab; click creation; no duplicate lesson calls; iframe/Source identity and draft retention; explanations/code, inspector, mobile views and l04 guide. Serverless file export: same tab/reuse checks, excluding guide playback.
verification.offline_limit: The l04 guided player uses direct iframe access, blocked by file:// same-origin isolation. Reproduced in the previous /tmp/gramlot-gallery-serverless-candidate.zip export; not introduced or repaired by this change.

public_deployment.registry_note: Examples Bun job initially could not resolve the freshly published core on one PyPI edge; the failed job and dependent publication jobs were rerun successfully after propagation. JSR publication completed without interruption.
public_deployment.browser_verification: Chromium and WebKit: both public hosts and extracted official ZIP; initial one pane/zero iframes, first-click Source, retained Source/iframe/Data, no repeat lesson RPC, code, inspector and mobile. Guided playback verified online only.

public_performance.method: Three fresh Chromium contexts per host, each with a cold and repeat visit. Same measurement script as the pre-change public HTTPS baseline. No concurrent browser test suite from this task during the after run. Sequential measurements at different times, not controlled simultaneous comparisons; small samples vary with network/server/client conditions.
public_performance.interpretation: The index starts faster in every public median. First selection now requires lesson/code Source requests and costs about 1.3 s versus 0.6–0.7 s before. Total index plus first example is nearly unchanged for Python cold and improves on Python repeat; it is slower for JavaScript in this public sample. Reopening an existing tab retains state and avoids another lesson request. The controlled private comparisons above showed a larger index and combined-time improvement; do not apply those percentages to these public samples.
